## Bathcat handoff — pre-approval head

Slug: `the-crew`

The frozen packet is under `intake/runs/2026-08-12-the-crew/`. It contains no approval and no canonical `KnowledgeBase/BoardGames/games/` tree. Local intake, provenance, visual, and diff gates passed. Contact sheet inspection found three distinct meaningful reduced references: official box identity, independent tabletop state, and independent card-hand state; none is replacement-quality for the manual or card library.

This is a Bathcat-authored, open draft, **pre-approval / DO NOT MERGE** head. Fresh Mennonite audit must independently reopen all seven receipts, inspect the staged canonical files and contact sheet, and decide GO/HOLD/REVISE. Bathcat will not approve, promote, or merge.

REVISE — exact head `a7c3cea94538fc483758a847e58e6e2b5913f42c`

Defect: two committed retrieval receipts are not reproducible at their declared URLs.

1. `src-001` (official Thames & Kosmos product page) records 457,308 bytes and SHA-256 `63d2c1060cc942fd01aaa6591891c6feda7999cbcdfdcddb48276db0db8fca5d`; fresh HTTP 200 retrieval during this audit produced 344,353 bytes and SHA-256 `34435bd5406e7f5d2d5fd974b8ea6bb526c06d07fcbd8b61e1a82923b975fc8d`.
2. `src-004` (The Family Gamers review page) records 134,420 bytes and SHA-256 `fc313e976753483f1530439873b3f80e4aa9d61f6ec7c05452cc700d6c16bc80`; fresh HTTP 200 retrieval produced SHA-256 `ab8ddcb55bc2609e00d7a410d6e092070393a3b400a1c9bbf3b5fbf31c4d2887`.

- Assumption: these receipts are stable evidence for the product identity and independent reception claims.
- Failure: the packet promotes claims on citation-shaped payloads later auditors cannot reproduce; dynamic-page drift also makes the recorded evidence text and byte custody uncertain.
- Evidence: committed `evidence.json` lines 103–169 versus fresh retrieval of the exact URLs on 2026-08-12; recorded and observed hashes differ. `src-002`, `src-003`, and all three visual asset hashes did match on independent retrieval.
- Cheapest test: recapture each unstable HTML source with a stable archived/static endpoint and inspect the new body for every claimed field, or replace each source with a stable official/independent document receipt. Then update dependent Source/Evidence/Confidence paths together.
- Mitigation: repair only the frozen Bathcat packet before approval; preserve the exact base-game edition boundary and do not add approval or canonical files.
- Abort condition: if a stable identity or reception document cannot be retrieved, remove the unsupported claims and narrow the packet rather than retaining the unstable receipt.

The contact sheet and three reduced visual panels were independently inspected: distinct, meaningful, non-corrupt, and non-substitutive. `validate-intake` passed. The pre-approval `intake-complete` failure is expected and is not a packet defect.

No files, approval, rejection record, or semantic repairs were written by Mennonite. Return the same PR with a new frozen head for a fresh audit.

REVISE — exact head `a7c3cea94538fc483758a847e58e6e2b5913f42c`

Defect: four consequential retrieval receipts are not reproducible at audit time.

- `src-001` official Thames & Kosmos product page: packet records 457,308 bytes / SHA-256 `63d2c1060cc942fd01aaa6591891c6feda7999cbcdfdcddb48276db0db8fca5d`; fresh HTTP 200 retrieval returned 469,712 bytes / SHA-256 `761d90a32c069f239d44e5e3d79407210fe94b18c3e563a0af65c2696cb8c65`.
- `src-003` Board Game Quest review: packet records 189,928 bytes / SHA-256 `41c7978d480122588dab7b5a57c955e460dac495e0654e96fcf5f337fe20cb94`; fresh HTTP 200 returned 3,248 bytes / SHA-256 `0741769f22a5f1dca1f93074a271cffb2f733d16da21ede0db7d15d0291b148f`.
- `src-004` The Family Gamers review: packet records 134,420 bytes / SHA-256 `fc313e976753483f1530439873b3f80e4aa9d61f6ec7c05452cc700d6c16bc80`; fresh HTTP 200 returned 134,508 bytes / SHA-256 `a62c3067e157aacbbfbecbe6eeda516b8eee7c81474b1903101c56bd71e403`.
- `src-006` Tabletop Bellhop visual: packet records 81,522 bytes / SHA-256 `005dba5cff74e2098a27e63db64e3f96773f0403fe6e253dc8507859fd85d10a`; fresh HTTP 200 returned 43,411 bytes / SHA-256 `ba465c59fe928529b59b108bb3b8a402316702643f45d9e20d5dbf5ab6d654d0`.

`src-002`, `src-005`, and `src-007` re-fetched with matching hashes. Those matches do not cure the four defective receipts.

Assumption: the committed receipts remain auditable proof for product identity, independent reception, and the visual packet.
Failure: promotion would bind claims or a visual to custody records that a later auditor cannot reproduce; dynamic-page drift may also invalidate the recorded evidence text.
Evidence: exact-head `evidence.json` and source registries versus fresh HTTP retrievals on 2026-08-12. The underlying game facts may remain true; this is a custody/reproducibility defect, not proof of factual change.
Cheapest test: recapture each unstable HTML/image source from a stable archived/static endpoint and inspect the new body/asset for every dependent claim, or replace it with a stable official/independent document receipt. Update the evidence receipt and every affected Source/Evidence/Confidence path together.
Mitigation: repair only the Bathcat packet on this PR before approval; preserve the exact Thames & Kosmos SKU 691868/base-game boundary and keep mission/card-text coverage explicitly outside scope. Do not add approval, rejection, or canonical files.
Abort condition: if a stable source cannot be retrieved and inspected, remove the dependent claim or visual and narrow the packet rather than retaining a citation-shaped promise. The expected pre-approval `intake-complete` failure is not a defect and is not part of this verdict.

No files, approval, rejection record, semantic repair, promotion, or merge was performed by Mennonite. Return the same PR with a new frozen head for a fresh exact-head audit.
